summary: SiteDocument is a class representing documents associated with a Site. It includes fields for ID and SiteID, and is implemented in the HSPnet.DataLayer namespace.
purpose: To model and manage documents associated with sites within the application.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page and class handling the welcome interface for staff administrators. It provides site and discipline selection, date filters, error/warning panels, and displays a grid of employment applications. It implements date validation, manages filtering and paging, and displays status and withdrawal info for applications.
purpose: To provide staff administrators with a welcome panel for viewing and managing employment applications, with filtering by site, discipline, and dates.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select site and discipline using dropdowns.
Set start and end dates using calendar controls.
Click Refresh to update the applications grid.
Applications are displayed with status and withdrawal date.
Row data is bound for each application, including name/email links.

business_rules: Employment applications are shown based on selected site, discipline, and date range.
Withdrawn applications are included/excluded based on checkbox.
validations: Start date and end date required.
Dates must follow the specified format.
End date must be after start date.
conditions: If start date > end date, validation fails.
If withdrawn date is null, status is 'Submitted'; otherwise, status is 'Withdrawn'.
content_gaps: No explicit workflow for application approval/rejection.
No details on error/warning panel messages.

summary: ServiceCode is an entity representing a coded service with attributes for categorization, naming, sorting, and notes, including alternate language fields. ServiceCodes provides methods to retrieve lists by various criteria.
purpose: To model and retrieve service codes used in course, timetable, and system configurations.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: The category associated with the service code.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to get all service codes.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID to get codes by course.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID to get codes by timetable.
Localize description if alternate language is enabled.

business_rules: If session is using alternate language fields, use NameAlt for description.
Service codes are retrieved using specific stored procedures.
conditions: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, Name is set to NameAlt.
system_behavior: Stored procedures return code lists by context (all, by course, by timetable).
content_gaps: No information on direct UI use or actor interaction.
